name: Torture and XeRo

tenures.source: Billed the reigning TWL World Tag Team Champions entering the promotion's own 26 January 1999 pay-per-view; the titles were declared vacant on that card after Torture failed to appear for their own scheduled defense.

caption: The reigning TWL World Tag Team Champions until one man's no-show and the other's on-air suspension cost them the belts.

name: Sex Sells

tenures.source: Won the vacant TWL World Tag Team Championship in a title-deciding ladder match on the promotion's own 21 February 1999 broadcast, aired as part of a crossover tournament card; still billed champions on the promotion's own 3 May 1999 broadcast.

caption: A cocky, self-promoting tag team who won the TWL World Tag Team Championship in a chaotic ladder match after its previous holders were stripped of the belts.
